title: Card Issue, Holder Age and Account Eligibility in the Mountain Dining Plans
content:
The card office issues the cards a Mountain Dining Plans plan includes, and the register below holds, for each plan, what the plan is carried on, how many cards it includes, what a further card and a replacement card cost, the youngest age a named holder may be, how many dependants may hold a card, and whether the plan is sold to corporate accounts as well as to households.

## Register of card issue and holder eligibility

| Plan | Carried on | Cards included | Fee per further card | Replacement card fee | Youngest named holder | Dependants who may hold a card | Sold to corporate accounts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mountain Bites Dining Card | a printed card | 1 | $10.00 | $15.00 | 13 years | 0 | no |
| Peak Plate Dining Plan | an RFID card | 2 | $10.00 | $15.00 | 13 years | 1 | no |
| Summit Table Dining Plan | an RFID card | 2 | $15.00 | $15.00 | 18 years | 1 | yes |
| Alpine Club Dining Membership | an RFID card | 4 | $0.00 | $0.00 | 21 years | 3 | yes |
| Chef's Table Dining Membership | a mobile wallet | 6 | $0.00 | $0.00 | 21 years | 5 | yes |
| Collective Hospitality Dining Membership | a mobile wallet | 10 | $0.00 | $0.00 | 21 years | 9 | yes |

## Points of judgement on the register

**A household asks what a fourth card would cost on a plan that includes two.** Two of the four are cards the plan includes and two are further cards. On the Peak Plate Dining Plan the fee per further card is $10.00, so two further cards are charged at that figure each; on the Summit Table Dining Plan the same two further cards are charged at $15.00 each. On the Alpine Club Dining Membership a further card is issued at $0.00, and so is a replacement.

**Which plans admit a dependant at all.** The Mountain Bites Dining Card admits none, so every card issued on it is the named holder's. Every other plan in the range admits at least one, rising to 9 on the Collective Hospitality Dining Membership.

**The two age lines in the range.** The two plans at the foot of the range open to a named holder of 13 years; the Summit Table Dining Plan raises that to 18 years, and the three memberships above it to 21 years.
